Begin Focus Areas Philosophy Investment Answers Meet Connect
{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}}

{{TAGLINE}}

You are invited into steady clinical attention that starts with how things show up for you now. Therapy here is practical, confidential, and shaped to the life you hold.

Schedule a conversation Plan a session

Quick arrival guide

Bring a sense of what you hope to change, the places it matters, and one recent moment that felt important.

  • Sessions: 45 or 60 minutes
  • Virtual and in-person options
  • Private, confidential notes kept in secure records
Contact: {{PHONE}} · {{EMAIL}}

How I work

My approach favors clear steps, shared planning, and practical tools you can use between sessions. We notice patterns, test small changes, and keep the aim readable: what would feel different in daily life?

Confidentiality & scope

Notes are part of a confidential clinical record. Therapy is not emergency care. If you are in crisis or concerned for safety, please contact local emergency services or the crisis resources in your area.

Boundaries

I do not provide forensic or legal assessments in routine sessions. For questions about records or limits of confidentiality, we will review these directly in your intake.

Practice framework

A simple scaffold we return to: Clarify — Try — Reflect. It keeps work anchored, measurable, and adaptable.

Clarify

Find a clear question to focus on. We translate a broad concern into a practical aim for sessions.

Try

Experiment with small behavioral or relational steps between sessions, then gather what changed.

Reflect

Make sense of results and revise the plan. Therapy stays collaborative and revisable.

Session planner

Create a compact plan to bring to your first appointment or to guide a single session.

Goals (pick up to 3)

Plan preview

No plan yet — use the planner to create one.

Self-screening & intake tools

Two short, clinician-designed exercises to prepare for a first meeting. These are not diagnoses; they help you bring useful questions and examples to the conversation.

Intake Compass

A guided, multi-step intake that builds a printable list of questions to bring to your consultation.

Questions to bring

Complete the steps to create questions to bring to your consultation.

Check-in Compass

A five question check-in that returns short, clinician-framing prompts you can show during an intake.

Prompts

No prompts yet.

Offerings

Flexible, clinician-led formats. Financial conversations are welcome — sliding scale and package options available on request.

Focused Sessions

45 min — $150

Concise, goal-oriented work to address a specific concern or decision.

Progress Series

Package — 6 sessions $840

A short, structured series for measurable change and skill-building.

Monthly Partnership

Subscription-style access — inquire

Ongoing weekly or biweekly sessions shaped to steady work over months.

Fees are listed as examples. Actual fees and insurance use will be discussed during intake. No guarantees implied.

What people notice

"Clear steps and practical takeaways — felt like a map after a foggy week."
"A clinician who listens and helps me make small, useful changes."

Ready to start?

When you're prepared, book a brief conversation to see if this is a good fit.

const copyPlan = document.getElementById('copyPlan'); const downloadPlan = document.getElementById('downloadPlan'); const preview = document.getElementById('planPreview'); const plannerForm = document.getElementById('plannerForm'); function gatherPlan(){ const fd = new FormData(plannerForm); const concern = fd.get('concern')||'Not specified'; const length = fd.get('length')||'45 minutes'; const sessions = fd.get('sessions')||'1'; const notes = fd.get('notes')||''; const goals = fd.getAll('goals'); const now = new Date().toLocaleString(); let text = `Session plan generated: ${now}\n`; text += `Primary concern: ${concern}\n`; text += `Session length: ${length}\n`; text += `Planned sessions: ${sessions}\n`; text += `Goals:\n`; if(goals.length) goals.forEach((g,i)=> text += ` ${i+1}. ${g}\n`); else text += ' Not specified\n'; text += `Notes for clinician:\n${notes || 'None'}\n`; return text; } buildBtn && buildBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){ const text = gatherPlan(); preview.textContent = text; copyPlan.disabled = false; downloadPlan.disabled = false; }); copyPlan && copyPlan.addEventListener('click', async function(){ try{ await navigator.clipboard.writeText(preview.textContent); copyPlan.textContent = 'Copied'; setTimeout(()=> copyPlan.textContent='Copy summary',1500); }catch(e){ alert('Copy failed — select and copy manually.'); } }); downloadPlan && downloadPlan.addEventListener('click', function(){ const blob = new Blob([preview.textContent],{type:'text/plain'}); const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob); const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = 'session-plan.txt'; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove(); URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }); // Intake Wizard (multi-step) const wizardForm = document.getElementById('wizardForm'); if(wizardForm){ const steps = Array.from(wizardForm.querySelectorAll('.step')); let i = 0; function showStep(idx){ steps.forEach((s,sidx)=> s.hidden = sidx !== idx); } showStep(0); wizardForm.addEventListener('click', function(e){ const action = e.target.getAttribute('data-action'); if(!action) return; if(action === 'next'){ i = Math.min(steps.length-1, i+1); showStep(i); } if(action === 'prev'){ i = Math.max(0, i-1); showStep(i); } }); const buildIntake = document.getElementById('buildIntake'); const wizardPreview = document.getElementById('wizardPreview'); const copyWizard = document.getElementById('copyWizard'); const downloadWizard = document.getElementById('downloadWizard'); buildIntake.addEventListener('click', function(){ const fd = new FormData(wizardForm); const concerns = fd.get('w.concerns') || 'Not specified'; const when = fd.get('w.when') || 'Not specified'; const coping = fd.get('w.coping') || 'Not specified'; const triggers = fd.get('w.triggers') || 'Not specified'; const outcomes = fd.get('w.outcomes') || 'Not specified'; const safety = fd.get('w.safety') || 'None reported'; // Create clinician-friendly questions to bring const questions = []; questions.push(`Can you say more about: ${concerns}? (examples of when it happens)`); questions.push(`When you first noticed this: ${when} — what changed around that time?`); questions.push(`What strategies help or hinder: ${coping} / ${triggers}?`); questions.push(`What would be a meaningful next step or sign of progress: ${outcomes}?`); if(safety && safety.trim()) questions.push(`Safety note: ${safety} — can we review a plan?`); const out = 'Intake Compass — questions to bring to your consultation:\n\n' + questions.map((q,i)=>`${i+1}. ${q}`).join('\n'); wizardPreview.textContent = out; copyWizard.disabled = false; downloadWizard.disabled = false; }); copyWizard.addEventListener('click', async ()=>{ try{ await navigator.clipboard.writeText(wizardPreview.textContent); copyWizard.textContent='Copied'; setTimeout(()=>copyWizard.textContent='Copy',1400);}catch(e){alert('Copy failed');} }); downloadWizard.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ const blob = new Blob([wizardPreview.textContent],{type:'text/plain'}); const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob); const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download='intake-questions.txt'; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove(); URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }); } // Quick check-in const quickForm = document.getElementById('quickForm'); const buildQuick = document.getElementById('buildQuick'); const quickPreview = document.getElementById('quickPreview'); const copyQuick = document.getElementById('copyQuick'); if(buildQuick){ buildQuick.addEventListener('click', function(){ const fd = new FormData(quickForm); const stress = fd.get('q.stress'); const sleep = fd.get('q.sleep'); const support = fd.get('q.support'); const worry = fd.get('q.worry') || 'Not specified'; const prompts = []; prompts.push(`Stress level today: ${stress} — any recent spikes or patterns?`); prompts.push(`Sleep note: ${sleep} — how does sleep affect your day-to-day?`); prompts.push(`Support: ${support} — who do you rely on, and how available are they?`); prompts.push(`Most pressing worry: ${worry} — an example that captures it?`); prompts.push(`One thing you want from the next session: (describe briefly)`); const out = 'Check-in Compass — short prompts:\n\n' + prompts.map((p,i)=>`${i+1}. ${p}`).join('\n'); quickPreview.textContent = out; copyQuick.disabled = false; }); copyQuick.addEventListener('click', async ()=>{ try{ await navigator.clipboard.writeText(quickPreview.textContent); copyQuick.textContent='Copied'; setTimeout(()=>copyQuick.textContent='Copy',1200);}catch(e){alert('Copy failed');} }); } });"} {"path":"assets/img/pattern.svg","content":" "} {"path":"robots.txt","content":"User-agent: * Allow: / Sitemap: /sitemap.xml "} {"path":"sitemap.xml","content":" /index.html weekly /about.html monthly /specialties.html monthly /approach.html monthly /fees.html monthly /faq.html monthly /book.html weekly /contact.html monthly "} BUNDLE_END
